name: Forgot password flow sends reset request and returns confirmation
description: Amended for credential isolation (PR #49 fix): requests a password reset for the DEDICATED recovery fixture user e2e.recovery@lanonasis.com so the suite login credential is never invalidated by the recovery flow. Ends at the confirmation message; never follows the email link or changes a password.

planSteps.description: Click the 'Forgot password?' link in the sign-in card
Fill e2e.recovery@lanonasis.com into the email field (dedicated recovery fixture user, NOT the suite login credential)
Verify the page shows a confirmation message like 'Check your email' or 'We sent a reset link'
